f_883bbeed75.name: l3_s35_normspread
f_883bbeed75.hypothesis: A station with several parallel gauges can show failure when one gauge departs from the others; normalizing the spread by the number of observed gauges helps distinguish a real process upset from a generally sparse readout.
f_883bbeed75.sql:

       CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3884 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3889 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3894 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3903 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3908 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3913 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
            THEN NULL
            ELSE (greatest(L3_S35_F3884, L3_S35_F3889, L3_S35_F3894, L3_S35_F3896, L3_S35_F3898, L3_S35_F3903, L3_S35_F3908, L3_S35_F3913) -
                  least(L3_S35_F3884, L3_S35_F3889, L3_S35_F3894, L3_S35_F3896, L3_S35_F3898, L3_S35_F3903, L3_S35_F3908, L3_S35_F3913)) /
                 (CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3884 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3889 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3894 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3896 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3898 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

       END AS l3_s35_normspread

f_7467768921.name: l3s32_branch_mode_flags
f_7467768921.hypothesis: Some parts appear to enter a special path at station L3_S32 and skip the normal L3_S33 flow. That looks like a rework or alternate tooling branch, and discrete machine-mode values at S32 sharply separate very bad branch states from the main path.
f_7467768921.sql:
SELECT
  d.Id,
  CASE WHEN d.L3_S32_D3852 IS NOT NULL AND d.L3_S33_D3856 IS NULL AND d.L3_S34_D3875 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3s32_only_branch,
  CASE WHEN d.L3_S32_D3852 IS NOT NULL AND d.L3_S33_D3856 IS NULL AND d.L3_S34_D3875 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3s32_to_s34_bypass,
  CASE WHEN d.L3_S32_D3852 IS NOT NULL AND d.L3_S33_D3856 IS NOT NULL AND d.L3_S34_D3875 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3_main_32_33_34,
  CASE WHEN c.L3_S32_F3854 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3s32_f3854_present,
  CASE WHEN try_cast(substr(c.L3_S32_F3854,2) AS BIGINT) IN (2,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3s32_f3854_highrisk,
  CASE WHEN try_cast(substr(c.L3_S32_F3854,2) AS BIGINT) = 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3s32_f3854_midrisk,
  CASE WHEN d.L3_S32_D3852 IS NOT NULL AND d.L3_S33_D3856 IS NULL AND try_cast(substr(c.L3_S32_F3854,2) AS BIGINT) IN (2,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3s32_only_highrisk_mode,
  CASE WHEN d.L3_S32_D3852 IS NOT NULL AND d.L3_S33_D3856 IS NULL AND d.L3_S34_D3875 IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(substr(c.L3_S32_F3854,2) AS BIGINT) = 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3s32_s34_midrisk_mode
FROM parts_date d
JOIN parts_categorical c USING (Id)

f_c59411e051.name: l3s32_mode_code
f_c59411e051.hypothesis: The parsed categorical code at L3_S32 behaves like a machine recipe or fixture state. A compact numeric code and coarse risk bucket may let the model isolate the bad alternate settings on this rare branch.
f_c59411e051.sql:
SELECT
  c.Id,
  try_cast(substr(c.L3_S32_F3854,2) AS BIGINT) AS l3s32_f3854_code,
  CASE 
    WHEN try_cast(substr(c.L3_S32_F3854,2) AS BIGINT) IN (2,4) THEN 3
    WHEN try_cast(substr(c.L3_S32_F3854,2) AS BIGINT) = 16 THEN 2
    WHEN try_cast(substr(c.L3_S32_F3854,2) AS BIGINT) IN (8,256,1,1152,-2147483648) THEN 1
    WHEN c.L3_S32_F3854 IS NULL THEN 0
    ELSE -1 END AS l3s32_f3854_risk_bucket
FROM parts_categorical c

f_91a2490d45.name: crossline_l3_source_mix

f_91a2490d45.sql:

  d.Id,
  CASE WHEN d.L3_S29_D3316 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_l3,
  CASE WHEN d.L0_S0_D1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_l0,
  CASE WHEN d.L1_S24_D677 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_l1,
  CASE WHEN d.L2_S26_D3037 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_l2,
  CASE WHEN d.L3_S29_D3316 IS NOT NULL AND d.L0_S0_D1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3_without_l0,
  CASE WHEN d.L3_S29_D3316 IS NOT NULL AND d.L0_S0_D1 IS NULL AND d.L1_S24_D677 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3_from_l1_not_l0,

f_d688cc3e5d.name: l3s33s34_sign_balance

  n.Id,
  (CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3855 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3857 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3859 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN n.L3_S34_F3876 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

  CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3855 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3857 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3859 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN n.L3_S34_F3876 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN n.L3_S34_F3878 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l3s33s34_mid_neg,
  CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3855 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3857 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN n.L3_S33_F3859 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN n.L3_S34_F3876 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
